name: MapLibre Native
role: GPU-accelerated C++ vector-tile map rendering SDK for native applications
notes: 2026-11-15: Assess because stateless map-frame rendering could make camera paths usable as frame sequences without browser capture. Revisit after verifying the CLI/binding and local tile, glyph and sprite inputs.
2026-11-15: Assessment uncertainty: official pages read did not establish release recency; verify a headless rendering automation route and current release history before promotion.
summary: Native library for rendering vector-tile maps in mobile and desktop applications using GPU acceleration. The official project documents platform SDK integration; a general headless frame-rendering CLI route was not established.
use_when: Embed interactive vector-tile maps in a native application
Use its platform SDK when browser map rendering is unsuitable
avoid_when: Use MapLibre GL JS for browser-based map scenes and capture
Use a static map renderer when you need a documented batch CLI

install.macos: Build for the target platform using the official platform-specific instructions and toolchain
install.check_command: Not applicable; no general CLI documented

assessment.version_seen: Current repository documentation; release version/date not confirmed
assessment.last_release: unknown (release date not established from pages read)
assessment.rationale: Official project documents an actively scoped native SDK and BSD-2-Clause licence, but the pages read do not establish a general CLI or headless frame-rendering path. Release recency is unverified; retain as a candidate pending automation evidence.
